title: Night Cream vs Sleeping Mask: What Is the Difference?
ex: A night cream is your everyday overnight moisturiser; a sleeping mask is an optional extra layer. How they differ and when a mask is worth adding.
rt: Night Cream vs Sleeping Mask: Do You Need Both? | Mirc Glow
rd: Night cream vs sleeping mask: how they differ, whether you need both, how to layer a mask over night cream, and which home face packs never to sleep in.
quick: A night cream is the everyday moisturiser you use every night. A sleeping mask is an optional leave-on layer, usually a hydrating gel, used two or three nights a week on top of your cream. Most people need a night cream; add a mask only if mornings still feel dry.
facts: Night cream first, sleeping mask on top
Two or three mask nights a week is enough
Never sleep in wash-off packs or sheet masks
Keep the extra layer plain if your cream has actives
